mapper.sql: input_id, session_thread_id, status, result, failure_code, accepted_at, started_at, completed_at, cancel_requested_at
request_id, input_id, dsh_session_id, session_thread_id, tool_use_id, turn, tool, input, available, public_event_id, state, decision
mapper.select: SELECT uuid, external_id, session_external_id FROM code_sessions WHERE organization_uuid = #{organizationUUID} AND workspace_uuid = #{workspaceUUID} AND session_uuid = #{sessionUUID} AND metadata #>> '{config,worker_protocol}' = 'dsr1' AND status = 'active' AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY created_at DESC, uuid DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO dsh_input_executions (organization_uuid, workspace_uuid, code_session_uuid, input_id, session_thread_id, accepted_at) VALUES (#{scope.OrganizationUUID}, #{scope.WorkspaceUUID}, #{scope.CodeSessionUUID}, #{inputID}, #{threadID}, #{acceptedAt}) ON CONFLICT (organization_uuid, workspace_uuid, code_session_uuid, input_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT FROM dsh_input_executions WHERE AND status IN ('accepted', 'running') ORDER BY CASE WHEN status = 'running' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, accepted_at, input_id LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM dsh_input_executions WHERE AND input_id = #{inputID}

WITH last_completed AS ( SELECT result, completed_at FROM dsh_input_executions WHERE AND status = 'completed' ORDER BY accepted_at DESC, input_id DESC LIMIT 1 ) SELECT (SELECT input_id FROM dsh_input_executions WHERE AND status = 'running' LIMIT 1) AS active_input_id, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dsh_input_executions WHERE AND status = 'accepted' AND (NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM last_completed) OR (SELECT result FROM last_completed) IN ('success', 'cancelled') OR accepted_at > (SELECT completed_at FROM last_completed))) AS has_eligible_accepted, (SELECT result FROM last_completed) AS last_result
mapper.update: UPDATE dsh_input_executions SET status = 'running', started_at = NOW() WHERE AND input_id = #{inputID} AND status = 'accepted'
UPDATE dsh_input_executions SET status = 'completed', result = #{result}, failure_code = #{failureCode}, completed_at = NOW() WHERE AND input_id = #{inputID} AND status = 'running'
mapper.select: SELECT FROM dsh_permission_requests WHERE AND request_id = #{requestID}
SELECT FROM dsh_permission_requests WHERE ORDER BY request_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO dsh_permission_requests (organization_uuid, workspace_uuid, code_session_uuid, request_id, input_id, dsh_session_id, session_thread_id, tool_use_id, turn, tool, input, available, worker_epoch, public_event_id, state, decision) VALUES (#{input.Scope.OrganizationUUID}, #{input.Scope.WorkspaceUUID}, #{input.Scope.CodeSessionUUID}, #{input.RequestID}, #{input.InputID}, #{input.DSHSessionID}, #{input.ThreadID}, #{input.ToolUseID}, #{input.Turn}, #{input.Tool,sensitive=true}, #{input.Input,sensitive=true}, #{input.Available}, #{input.Scope.Epoch}, #{input.PublicEventID}, #{input.State}, #{input.Decision,sensitive=true})
mapper.update: UPDATE dsh_permission_requests SET state = #{state}, decision = #{decision,sensitive=true}, resolved_at = NOW() WHERE AND request_id = #{requestID} AND state = 'pending'
mapper.select: SELECT payload_digest FROM dsh_public_receipts WHERE AND event_id = #{eventID}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO dsh_public_receipts (organization_uuid, workspace_uuid, code_session_uuid, event_id, payload_digest) VALUES (#{scope.OrganizationUUID}, #{scope.WorkspaceUUID}, #{scope.CodeSessionUUID}, #{eventID}, #{payloadDigest,sensitive=true})
mapper.update: UPDATE dsh_transcripts SET session_thread_id = #{threadID} WHERE AND dsh_session_id = #{dshSessionID} AND (session_thread_id IS NULL OR session_thread_id = #{threadID})
